name: Mizu Ren Nanami
original_name: มิซึ เรน นานามิ
source:
Etymology: Mizu = Water | Ren = Water | Nanami = Seven Seas
Age: 16
Nationality: Ren
Role: Exchange Student
Personality: Optimistic and unique, viewing the world through an outsider's lens. Independent and steadfast in her values, she is observant, patient, and rarely angered. While new situations make her anxious, her sensitivity allows her to adapt, and she is fiercely protective of her loved ones. Though creative in problem-solving, she sometimes hesitates with major decisions—reflecting her journey toward self-reliance.

[From in-game profile]
